about:
# RollTracker

A small World of Warcraft addon for **WoW Forever** (client 1.60.x, Interface `16001`).

Whenever a group loot roll happens while you're in a group (in a dungeon or out in the world), a card appears just above your chat window. Each card shows:

- the **item** (icon and quality-coloured name; hover for the tooltip, shift-click to link it in chat)
- **every party member** and what they picked: Need, Need (OS), Transmog, Greed, Pass, or `...` while they're still choosing
- each player's **roll number**
- the **winner**, highlighted in gold with a check mark (or "Everyone passed")

Cards **stack upward**, with the newest on top, and **stay until you close them**: click the **X** or right-click the card.

```
 ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
 │▌[icon] Cape of the Black Baron        X │  <- newest
 │▌       Rolling... 41s  2/5 chose  21:40 │
 │ ─────────────────────────────────────── │
 │  Sylvanas         Greed            64   │
 │  Me               Pass                  │
 │  ...                                    │
 └─────────────────────────────────────────┘
 ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
 │▌[icon] Thunderfury, Blessed Blade...  X │
 │▌       Won by Thrallson (Need 87) 21:37 │
 │ ─────────────────────────────────────── │
 │▓ Thrallson        Need             87 ✓▓│
 │  Me               Need             42   │
 │  Jaina            Greed            99   │
 │  Anduin           Pass                  │
 └─────────────────────────────────────────┘
 ═══════════════ chat window ═══════════════
```

## Suitability badges

A row that picked **Need** can get a badge next to the choice:

- **Red ✕: can't use.**
  - The armor is heavier than the class can wear. Warriors and Paladins only wear Plate from level 40, Hunters and Shamans only Mail from 40.
  - The class can't use that weapon type, shield, libram, idol or totem.
  - The item has a *Classes:* line that excludes the player (tier tokens and set pieces).
  - The player is below the item's required level.
- **Amber !: questionable.**
  - Lighter armor than the class's best, e.g. a level-60 Warrior Needing leather.
  - The item only has stats the class doesn't use, e.g. a Mage Needing an Agility sword. Shamans and Druids never get this warning.

Hover the row to see why it was flagged. Rules:

- Need (OS) rows are only flagged when the item can't be used. Greed, Transmog and Pass rows are never flagged in the default mode.
- Rings, necks, trinkets and cloaks only get the stat check.
- Items that aren't gear, such as consumables, get no badge.
- Armor and weapon types are known instantly. Stats, *Classes:* lines and required level appear once the game has loaded the item.

`/rtr test` includes one red row (a Priest Needing a sword) and one amber row (a Warrior Needing leather).

## Install

### From a release (easiest)

1. Download `RollTracker-<version>.zip` from the [latest release](https://github.com/RehakOndrej/wow-roll-tracker/releases/latest).
2. Unzip it into your game's `Interface\AddOns\` folder (see step 2–3 below for where that is). You should end up with `Interface\AddOns\RollTracker\RollTracker.toc`.
3. Start the game (or `/reload`) and type `/rtr test`.

### From source

1. Quit WoW, or plan to `/reload` after copying.
2. Find the WoW Forever game folder. In the Battle.net launcher, pick WoW Forever, click the gear icon next to *Play*, then **Show in Explorer** (Windows) or **Show in Finder** (macOS).
3. Inside that folder, open `Interface\AddOns\`. Create the `Interface` and `AddOns` folders if they don't exist yet.
4. Copy the **`RollTracker`** folder from this repo into it. The result should look like this:
   ```
   ...\Interface\AddOns\RollTracker\RollTracker.toc
   ...\Interface\AddOns\RollTracker\Core.lua
   ...\Interface\AddOns\RollTracker\Recorder.lua
   ...\Interface\AddOns\RollTracker\Suitability.lua
   ...\Interface\AddOns\RollTracker\UI.lua
   ...\Interface\AddOns\RollTracker\Panel.lua
   ```
   Copy the inner `RollTracker` folder itself, not the whole repo and not a folder nested one level too deep.
5. Start the game. On the character screen, click **AddOns** and make sure **RollTracker** is ticked.
   - If it shows as *out of date*, tick **Load out of date AddOns**, or change the `## Interface:` line in `RollTracker.toc` to the number shown by `/dump select(4, GetBuildInfo())` in game.
6. In game, type `/rtr test` to see two demo cards.

## Panel & minimap menu

Click the minimap **AddOns** button and choose **RollTracker**, or type `/rtr`. That opens a small panel:

- **Status line**: the current mode, whether rolls are tracked *right here* and why ("not in a group"...), and how many cards are open.
- **Recent rolls**: the last 20 rolls, including cards you already closed. Click a closed one to show it again. Shift-click links the item in chat. Hover for the item tooltip.
- **Settings**: everything below is also available as a `/rtr` command.
  - Track rolls: In a group / Dungeons only / Always
  - Suitability badges: Off / Need rolls / Everyone
  - Card scale (−/+)
  - Locked / Move
  - Recording: Off / On, and "Replay last"
  - Buttons: Show test cards, Clear cards, Reset position

In the AddOns menu, left-click toggles Recent rolls and right-click opens Settings. Esc closes the panel. The menu entry only appears when RollTracker is enabled for all characters on the AddOns screen.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `/rtr` or `/rtr show` | Open / close the panel (Recent rolls) |
| `/rtr config` | Open the panel on Settings |
| `/rtr help` | List all commands |
| `/rtr test` | Show demo cards (works anywhere) |
| `/rtr clear` | Close all cards |
| `/rtr unlock` / `/rtr lock` | Show a drag bar to move the stack, then lock it again |
| `/rtr scale 1.2` | Scale the cards (0.5 – 2) |
| `/rtr reset` | Move the stack back above the chat and reset the scale |
| `/rtr mode group` | *(default)* Track rolls whenever you're in a group, inside or outside dungeons |
| `/rtr mode instance` | Track rolls only inside dungeons and raids |
| `/rtr mode always` | Always track rolls |
| `/rtr fit need` | *(default)* Flag Need rolls on gear that doesn't suit the player's class |
| `/rtr fit all` / `/rtr fit off` | Show the fit for every row (green dot = fits) / hide all badges |
| `/rtr record on` / `/rtr record off` | Start / stop saving real roll events (`/rtr record` shows status) |
| `/rtr recordings` | List saved recordings |
| `/rtr recordings clear [#]` | Delete one recording, or all of them |
| `/rtr replay [#] [speed]` | Play a recording back (default: the latest, instantly; `speed` 1 = real time, 2 = 2x...) |
| `/rtr replay stop` | Stop a timed replay |

`/rolltracker` works as a longer alias.

## Record & replay

To check or debug the addon without waiting for a real roll:

1. In a dungeon, type `/rtr record on`, then do some loot rolls as usual.
2. Type `/rtr record off`. Recordings are written to disk on logout or `/reload`, under `WTF/Account/<ACCOUNT>/SavedVariables/RollTracker.lua`.
3. Later, anywhere (even solo in a city), type `/rtr replay` to rebuild the same cards.

What a recording contains:

- For every roll event: the raw event arguments, plus a snapshot of what the addon read from the game at that moment. That means the item link and icon, the full loot-history info, and the party roster when it changed.
- Every chat roll line.

That's enough for a replay to run through exactly the same code at home. Chat text the game hid from addons (Midnight "secret values") can't be saved. It shows up as a marker counted in `/rtr recordings`.

Limits:

- The last 20 recordings are kept, with up to 3000 events each.
- Recording stays on across `/reload` and starts a new session after each reload.
- Replayed events are never recorded again.
- Replayed cards never mix with real ones.

## Troubleshooting

- **`/rtr` says "Type '/help' for a listing…"**: the addon isn't loaded. On the character screen, open **AddOns** and check:
  - RollTracker is ticked.
  - It isn't marked *out of date*. If it is, tick **Load out of date AddOns**.
  - It isn't listed with an error such as *Missing* or *Corrupt*.
- **A command stays stuck in the chat box**: the addon hit a Lua error. Since 1.1.1, every `/rtr` command catches its own errors and prints them in red in chat, so the box always clears. To see full errors, run `/console scriptErrors 1` once and `/reload`. Please report the red text.
- `/rtr debug` turns on detailed messages for event handling.

## How it works

The addon combines three data sources, so a roll still shows up when one source is missing:

1. **`START_LOOT_ROLL`** opens a card the moment the roll window appears, with the icon and a countdown.
2. **`C_LootHistory`** (`LOOT_HISTORY_UPDATE_DROP`) is the authoritative source. It provides every player's choice, roll and the winner. This is the same data as Blizzard's loot-history frame.
3. **Chat parsing** of the `CHAT_MSG_LOOT` / `CHAT_MSG_SYSTEM` lines ("X has selected Need for: …", "Need Roll - 87 for … by X", "X won: …") is the fallback. The patterns are built from the client's own localized strings, so other game languages work too. When the client sends chat as a Midnight "secret value" (inside instances during combat), those lines are skipped and the loot history fills the card in.

Chat lines and loot-history updates that describe the same roll are merged into one card. If a second copy of the same item drops, it gets its own card. When history data can't be read during combat, the addon re-reads it once combat ends.

Drops that were already decided before you logged in or reloaded are not shown again, and a card you closed never comes back. Open cards are not saved across `/reload`.

The stack keeps at most 12 cards. When a 13th card arrives, the oldest one is removed.

## Development

The tests run outside the game against a small mock of the WoW API (Lua 5.4):

```sh
luac -p RollTracker/*.lua      # syntax check
lua tests/run_tests.lua        # parser, model, UI, record/replay and suitability tests
```

To build a release zip (contains only the `RollTracker/` folder):

```sh
git archive --format=zip -o RollTracker-$(grep -m1 '## Version' RollTracker/RollTracker.toc | awk '{print $3}').zip HEAD RollTracker
```
